Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time on the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we have everything aligned: 

What we heard:
- Primary use case: ingest clinical notes + customer support transcripts to generate succinct case summaries and suggested next actions for care coordinators.
- Scale: ~20M tokens / month initially, expected to double within 9–12 months.
- Success criteria: end-to-end latency < 400ms for single-turn generation, 90th pct cost per request target, and strict PHI handling in private deployment.

Open questions we flagged:
- Data residency & encryption requirements (KMS/HSM) — you mentioned SOC2 + HIPAA constraints.
- Typical inference concurrency patterns for peak hours.
- Your preferred rollout timeline for a pilot (Q4 vs early Q1).

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) to confirm timelines, security guardrails, and procurement cadence — this will help unblock a technical deep dive/demo.
2) Technical deep dive/demo with our infra/ML eng team (30–45m) to cover architecture, deployment options (Hosted vs Private), and quantization/latency tradeoffs.

Are you and your CTO available for a short exec intro next week? I can propose two windows — Tue Aug 1 10:00am PT or Wed Aug 2 9:00am PT. If those don't work, share a couple of alternatives and I'll coordinate.

Attaching a short overview of the Redwood platform for your execs (redwood_platform_overview.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

—
